policy: Profiles count missing keys relative to objects actually present at each nested path; empty parent containers do not contribute child objects.
Placeholder tokens are candidates only. Literal Not Present or Not Applicable can be meaningful; no global null replacement is made. Zero and False are populated values.
Normalized names use Unicode NFKC, case folding and whitespace only. No punctuation removal, fuzzy matching or semantic equivalence is asserted.
UPC/SKU comparisons remove whitespace only, preserve leading zeros, and do not verify barcode ownership, check digits or product identity.
Ingredient-ID/name and UNII-shape findings are profiling candidates, not approved cross-source identities or authoritative registry validation.
Relationship targets outside the 400-label sample are unresolved locally, not necessarily broken links. Asymmetric source annotations need not be errors.
Entry dates describe DSLD entry, not manufacture, revision, expiry or current availability.
Statement coverage measures text availability, not accuracy, effectiveness, complete safety coverage or independent evidence. Claim codes are classification metadata, not extracted clinical claims.

Baseline structural/quality profiling is now sufficient for shared-schema discussion together with previous quantity and duplicate audits. Label-image verification, clinical review, full semantic deduplication and source vocabulary definitions remain unresolved.

field_dictionary.label: One source label record, not necessarily one unique commercial product.
field_dictionary.id: DSLD label identifier; use source namespace.
field_dictionary.upcSku: Source UPC/SKU text; not assumed unique or externally verified.
field_dictionary.ingredientRows: Listed ingredient tree; preserve nested membership and attached quantities/forms.
field_dictionary.ingredientRows[].quantity: Reported amount/operator/unit and serving reference; daily-value metadata is separate.
field_dictionary.forms: Ingredient forms attached to the parent ingredient; do not assign parent amount independently to each form.
field_dictionary.otheringredients: Separate ingredient list/free text; do not infer absent amounts or combine with active-dose rows.
field_dictionary.statements: Typed source label text (directions, precautions, general claims etc.); preserve original wording.
field_dictionary.claims: Source claim classification codes/descriptions, not independently validated clinical facts.
field_dictionary.servingSizes: Serving sizes, daily-serving bounds and notes; source nulls remain unknown.
field_dictionary.labelRelationships: Source-asserted label links with relation type; targets can lie outside the sample.
field_dictionary.entryDate/events: Source entry date and typed events; not a clinical freshness guarantee.
field_dictionary.offMarket: Source market-status flag; retain historical labels.
field_dictionary.remaining_fields: Observed JSON types/states are documented in field_profiles.json; business semantics not established by profiling alone.
